title: Still-water hydrostatic pressure profile p(y) = rho0 g (H - y)

reference.provenance: closed form; the same hydrostatic-tank reference is used by Adami, Hu & Adams, J. Comput. Phys. 231 (2012) 7057-7075 and by this repository's benchmarks/hydrostatic/run.py. Reference values are evaluated from the closed form at the measured band centres (no table transcription).
